items.headline: Semiconductor index extends rally as AI-infrastructure orders broaden beyond the megacaps
items.summary: The PHLX Semiconductor Index closed at a record, with breadth improving as second-tier suppliers and networking names joined the move. Analysts cite order backlogs extending into 2027.

items.headline: Cloud capex guidance lifted across three hyperscalers; supply chain seen tight through year-end
items.summary: Aggregate 2026 cloud capex guidance rose roughly 9% quarter-over-quarter. Component lead times for advanced packaging and HBM remain the gating constraint, suppliers say.

items.headline: Money rotates from defensives into cyclical tech as breadth widens
items.summary: Fund-flow data show a third straight week of rotation out of staples and utilities into semis, hardware, and capital-equipment names.

items.headline: Advanced-packaging capacity additions announced by two foundries amid HBM shortage
items.summary: Two leading foundries detailed CoWoS and HBM capacity expansions for 2026-2027, aiming to ease a bottleneck that has constrained AI-accelerator shipments.

items.headline: Export-control review widens to additional accelerator SKUs; sector braces for headline risk
items.summary: Officials signaled a review of licensing thresholds covering more data-center accelerator configurations. No final rule issued; timing uncertain.

items.headline: Fed officials signal patience on rate path; markets read a steady-for-longer stance
items.summary: Several policymakers emphasized data dependence. Rates futures little changed on the week.

items.headline: Enterprise software demand steadies as IT budgets shift toward AI deployment
items.summary: Channel checks suggest enterprises are reallocating rather than expanding IT budgets, prioritizing AI tooling and inference infrastructure over legacy renewals.
